_meanings:
.²1 A sacrificial fire.
.²2 A festival, holiday.
.²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a Yādava, uncle and friend of Kṛṣṇa. [When Kṛṣṇa was
 taken by Akrūra to Maṭhurā, Uddhava was implored by the citizens of
 Gokula to go and fetch him. He was very much attached to Kṛṣṇa. On
 seeing the destruction of the Yādavas to be inevitable, he went to Kṛṣṇa
 and asked him what to do; whereupon he was told to go to Badarikāśrama
 to practise penance and to secure heaven. He is the subject of two short
 poems, {#udDavadUta#} and {#udDavasaMdeSa#}.]
